name: Proxmox VE Infrastructure
description: Infrastructure metrics for Proxmox VE, grouped like with like: cluster health, Ceph and disk storage, backups and replication, certificate and subscription expiry, and node service state.

config.name: Cluster Health
config.description: Health Score is nodes online weighted by how stalled each one is (pressure stall figures), 0 without quorum; 100 is every node online and unstalled. It warns below 70 and errors below 50.

config.name: Ceph Health
config.description: Blank on a cluster without Ceph: every Ceph datapoint except CephAvailable is withheld there. PGs Not Clean is non-zero during normal recovery and rebalancing.

config.name: Cluster Health Over Time
config.description: Only the resource collecting for the cluster draws a line; the standby's stays empty unless it stood in.

config.name: Ceph OSDs and Monitors
config.description: Cluster-wide counts from ceph status. OSDs Out is expected during a planned rebalance.

config.name: Ceph Raw Utilisation
config.description: Raw capacity across all OSDs, before replication. Ceph degrades well before it is full.

config.name: OSD Fill
config.description: An uneven spread across OSDs points at CRUSH weighting.
Reweight below 1.0 means the OSD has been down-weighted. A large PG imbalance across OSDs indicates a CRUSH or weighting problem.
config.name: Ceph OSDs

config.description: SMART OK is empty where SMART Known is 0, and Life Left is empty where Wear Reported is 0 -- a spinning disk exposes no wear attribute, so the blank means not applicable rather than not collected. A datapoint cannot print "N/A": LogicMonitor takes numbers only.
config.name: Physical Disks
Backups
config.description: Totals across every guest: guests no backup job covers, guests whose backup has failed since their last good one, and the size of each guest's latest backup added up (Proxmox Backup Server runs log no size). Per guest and per job, see Proxmox VE Cluster Backups on the resource holding the cluster role.
Replica Age is empty for a job that has never run.
config.name: Replication Jobs

config.description: One row per certificate per node: the cluster CA, pve-ssl and pveproxy-ssl expire independently.
config.name: Certificates

config.description: Days to Renewal is empty on a node with no subscription. One row per node: the module is single-instance, so rows carry the node's name.
config.name: Subscriptions

config.description: Running ships without a threshold: several Proxmox services are legitimately stopped on a node that does not use them. Failed is the one that means something broke.
config.name: Node Services
